reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Fears and uncertainties but new opportunities
themes.definition: The AI revolution acknowledged as bringing fears and uncertainties but framed primarily as an opportunity for a better world if designed to serve everyone.
themes.inclusion: Include passages pairing AI-related fears with opportunities, especially with an optimistic, conditional emphasis.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that specify concrete risks or governance mechanisms.
themes.boundary_cases: The 'designed to serve everyone' condition may also indicate AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE if inequality is elaborated; here it is not.

examples.quote: The digital economy and the artificial-intelligence revolution bring with them fears and uncertainties, but above all they offer new opportunities for a better world

themes.label: AI within prosperity and innovation agenda
themes.definition: AI situated in a pro-market narrative of prosperity, entrepreneurship, innovation and trade.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI to economic prosperity, entrepreneurship and the digital economy.
themes.exclusion: Exclude labour-disruption warnings without an economic-growth frame.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief digital economy mentions count only when AI is explicitly named.

examples.quote: We want a more prosperous world, with more shared development and the freedom to be entrepreneurial and to innovate, create and trade.

value.rationale: Single 2018 Belgian passage placing the AI revolution in an optimistic prosperity and innovation narrative while briefly acknowledging fears and uncertainties.
